lesson.headline: JLPT N1 (Advanced) — Literary Grammar & Classical Particles
lesson.lead: Reaching professional and fluent level competency. Analyzing formal written articles, legislative draftings, literary texts, and ancient classical remnants.
bullets: Autobiographical & Compelled Action: 〜ずにはおかない (zuni wa okanai - will not stop until / cannot help but execute).
Simultaneous Occurrences: 〜がてら (gatera - while also taking the opportunity to complete a secondary task, e.g. "walking while buying groceries").
Classical Similes: 〜ごとき (gotoki - classical remnant meaning "like" or "as if" / 怒涛のごとく - like a raging torrent).
Advanced Kanji Compounds: Reading and writing highly technical, philosophical, and specialized characters (e.g. 緻密 - chimitsu - highly detailed).

quizzes.q: Which advanced N1 grammar pattern represents "will not stop until" or "compelled to execute"?
options: ずにはいられない (zuni wa irarenai)
ずにはおかない (zuni wa okanai)
べきではない (beki de wa nai)
quizzes.explain: 〜ずにはおかない (zuni wa okanai) is a strong, formal expression indicating that the speaker or an event will inevitably cause something to happen, or cannot stop until it is completed.

quizzes.q: Identify the pattern meaning "while also taking the opportunity to do" (e.g. "taking a walk while also picking up dinner")?
quizzes.explain: 〜がてら (gatera) is an advanced connector indicating a primary activity (e.g. 散歩 - walking) during which one conveniently completes a secondary task.

quizzes.q: What is the classical grammatical meaning of the N1 particle remnant "〜ごとき" (gotoki)?
quizzes.explain: 〜ごとき (gotoki) is a classical Japanese remnant equivalent to the modern 〜のような (no you na), meaning "like / in the manner of / as if".

quizzes.q: Identify the correct reading and meaning of the N1 advanced compound "緻密" (e.g. 緻密な計画).
quizzes.explain: 緻密 is read as "ちみつ" (chimitsu) meaning highly detailed, precise, or minute. E.g. 緻密な計画 (a meticulous/highly precise plan).

quizzes.q: Which N1 grammar connector acts as a formal "because" or "due to" (often in writing or public statements)?
quizzes.explain: 〜ゆえに (yue ni) is a formal, literary particle meaning "because of / due to," expressing a causal link between clauses. Equivalent to 〜ために.

quizzes.q: What does the N1 suffix "〜ずくめ" (zukume) mean when added to a noun (e.g. 黒ずくめの服)?
quizzes.explain: 〜ずくめ (zukume) means "entirely filled with / nothing but / covered in". E.g. 黒ずくめの服 (clothes entirely of black / dressed in all black).
